Turns up to 10 mB/t of steam into FE: 8, 14 or 22 FE per mB by grade (80 to 220 FE/t).
One Superheated boiler keeps a turbine about 40% busy, so run two or three boilers per turbine.
Heavy Oil in its lubricant tank (1,000 mB, through a lubricant face) adds 8% to its output, using 1 mB every 5 seconds while it generates.
